user.title: Glass Message Board
user.description: Adds a household message board. The glass card is loaded automatically — add it to a dashboard as "Glass Message Board".

abort.already_configured: The message board is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: The message board is already set up.

init.title: Notifications & defaults
init.description: For each person, pick the notify service(s) that should ping them when a note is left for them (for example notify.mobile_app_pixel). Notes to "Everyone" ping every person below except the sender.

data.notify_everyone: Extra services for notes to everyone
data.notify_url: Open this dashboard path when a notification is tapped (e.g. /lovelace/notes)

post.name: Leave a note
post.description: Post a message to the glass board.

to.name: To
to.description: A person entity, a board member id (member.xxxx), or "everyone".

from.name: From
from.description: Person entity or board member id of the sender. Defaults to the user running the action.

sender_name.name: Sender name
sender_name.description: Name to show when not sent by a person (e.g. "Home" or "Washer").

clear.name: Clear the board
clear.description: Remove all notes (pinned notes are kept unless included).

set_background.name: Change the background
set_background.description: Switch the board's colour theme on every screen. Use a preset, or "custom" with three colours.
